PLAINTIFF REYNALDO BERRIOS, SON OF MARIA CARMEN COREA WILL SPEAK ON BEHALF OF MARIA CARMEN COREA, MOTHER. DEFENDANT 2649-51 MISSION ST APARTMENTS G.P IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT AEROVIAS DEL CONTINENTE AMERICANO S.A. AVIANCA IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT IMPERIAL TRAVEL SERVICES IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY IVETTE GOMEZ (CO-OWNER/MANAGER) AND PETER GOMEZ (OWNER). NO VALID PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE ON AEROVIAS DEL CONTINENTE AMERICANO S.A. AVIANCA. PLAINTIFFS REQUEST TO DISMISS DEFENDANT AEROVIAS DEL CONTINENTE AMERICANO S.A. AVIANCA TO MOVE FORWARD ON HEARING. COURT DISMISSED DEFENDANT 2649-51 MISSION ST APARTMENTS G.P. WITH PREJUDICE AS THE CORRECT BUSINESS NAME IS IMPERIAL TRAVEL SERVICE THAT IS ALREADY A NAMED DEFENDANT IN THIS CASE. AS STATED BY IVETTE GOMEZ THE CORRECT BUSINESS NAME IS IMPERIAL TRAVEL SERVICE. COURT AMENDED DEFENDANT IMPERIAL TRAVEL SERVICES TO CORRECT NAME IMPERIAL TRAVEL SERVICE. COURT CONTACTED ANTONIO, SON OF PLAINTIFF REYNALDO BERRIOS TO TESTIFY. NO EXHIBITS RETAIN. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
